verdict.rationale: The docs say conversation flow settings govern user silence, interruptions and turn-taking behavior, and that turn-taking and timeouts are configurable, so the turn-taking axis is addressed. Nothing in the pack says end-of-turn detection is model-based rather than a VAD/silence-timeout mechanism, which is the heart of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of a model-based end-of-turn or turn-detection model, evidence of handling for slow or pausing speakers beyond timeout tuning, any configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
